# Use Polaris with the Shopify dev MCP server

Learn how to enable Polaris tooling in the Shopify dev MCP server to accelerate app development.

---

##

- You must have [node](https://nodejs.org/en) version 20 or higher installed.
- You need a LLM-enabled development environment that's capable of integrating with [Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol).

---

##

Run the following command to start the Shopify dev MCP server:

## Terminal

---

##

You can add the `npx -y @shopify/dev-mcp@latest` command for different dev environments to add the MCP integration:

## File

{

"mcpServers": {

"shopify-dev-mcp": {

"command": "npx",

"args": ["-y", "@shopify/dev-mcp@latest"]

}

}

}

After configuring your tooling, be sure to tell your agent to use available tools that help you build with web components across all supported surfaces.

---

##

Learn about the various surfaces where you can use web components:

- [App Home](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home)
- [Admin UI extensions](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-extensions)
- [Checkout UI extensions](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/checkout-ui-extensions)
- [Customer Account UI extensions](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/customer-account-ui-extensions)
- [POS UI extensions](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/pos-ui-extensions)
